items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I think Marty's tired, you know, he just keep up there too

ctx.x: How was his range? Did he play up high a good deal or down low? Did he hit a lot of high notes or low or how was, what kind of a song? Bust right on out.

Everything right on out. Up to the top. Never seen him, put his arm like a full thing, you know. I think Marty's tired, you know, he just keep up there too, look around, and he's a man to get ready to go out. The horn.
Did you ever use a mute or anything?
